_what: Extension candidates for the secondary benchmark, screened 2026-09-02 from the ASD 2023 bulk release plus live RCSB, UniProt and PubMed metadata.
_frame: ASD Release 5.01/5.1 (2023-06 / 2023-09), 2419 XML entry files, 3147 allosteric-site records. ASD is a RECALL DEVICE only. Clause (ii) is NOT established for any row here.
_no_residues: By design this file names NO allosteric-site residue. Clause (ix) is reported as a chain COUNT and chain IDs, never as residue identities, so that this file is not an answer key and docs/benchmark/review/ does not become a seventh unguarded leak route.

_screening_method.clause_ix: Measured live on the RCSB biological assembly (files.rcsb.org/download/<PDB>-assembly1.cif.gz), model 1, effector heavy atoms vs protein heavy atoms at 4.5 A, grouped by label_asym_id so that symmetry copies are distinguished. This is the same measurement tests/test_secondary.py makes. Prescreened first on ASD's own chain-annotated residue field, which killed 487 records before any download.
_screening_method.clause_xi: RCSB rcsb_entry_info.resolution_combined and exptl.method. X-ray <= 2.5 A, cryo-EM <= 4.0 A (ADR 0009 clause 2).
_screening_method.clause_xii: Pfam read from the ASD XML Pfam_ID field and cross-checked against RCSB polymer-entity Pfam annotations. The 27 blocked families were READ from docs/benchmark/primary/manifest.yaml and docs/benchmark/secondary/manifest.yaml, not recalled. Within-set disjointness enforced greedily, physiological effectors and small proteins first.
_screening_method.clause_iv: UniProt accession identity between the apo and holo entries, from RCSB polymer-entity container identifiers. A sequence-identity measurement was NOT run.
_screening_method.clause_iii_x: NOT MEASURED. An apo entry holding the effector component itself was hard-excluded. Every other apo component is listed for a site-relative distance measurement that this sweep did not run.
_screening_method.clause_ii: NOT ESTABLISHED for any row. The DOI on each row is ASD's own curation reference, resolved from its PubMed id via NCBI esummary on 2026-09-02. NOBODY HAS READ THESE PAPERS. The 2026-08-24 sweep measured clause (ii) at a 29 % kill rate on candidates that had already passed every structural clause; expect the same here.

_tiers.A_structurally_admissible: Every structural clause this sweep can measure passes, and the apo carries no non-cryoprotectant component. Ready for a clause (ii) literature pass.
_tiers.B_apo_occupant_to_measure: Same, except the apo carries a component that must be measured against the site. Most will be the enzyme's own cofactor at the ACTIVE site, which the repo's site-apo clause (iii) permits; some will not be.
_tiers.B_one_effector_copy_only: Clause (ix) passes on at least one effector copy in the assembly but not on all of them. The arm must name that chain, and a reviewer will ask why.
_tiers.D_unmeasured: The assembly or the effector could not be retrieved.

_asd_provenance.licence: Research use only. Users will not be allowed to distribute the data to a third party. The archives live under data/external/asd/, which .gitignore excludes. DO NOT COMMIT THEM AND DO NOT REDISTRIBUTE ANY VERBATIM ASD FILE.
